items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I saw her playing with Ernie Wilkins, he had a big band at Carnegie Hall.

ctx.x: She did the "Salute to Women in Jazz" at the concert we did in June down at the Symphony Space.
She played with a big band, this guy was -- Ernie Wilkins. I saw her playing with Ernie Wilkins, he had a big band at Carnegie Hall.
